idle.note: the protagonist's cut-out bob: the upper body drops 2 px and returns as one rigid piece; the staff arm and staff stay planted; robe and feet still

move.note: a hunched hobble: four short shuffles per tile under the robe, the staff swung ahead and leaned on twice, a 1 px dip per shuffle

mark.note: raises the staff straight up 26 px, upright, hood tipped back to listen, free hand lifted open; holds; then thrusts it forward and tips the crystal 30 degrees down the marked line (contact)

land.note: lifts the upright staff 12 px, then drives its butt straight down to the floor (contact) with a hunched lurch; the robe top jolts 1 px and settles

bolt.note: a small wind-back, then the crystal tips 28 degrees at the target from the grip as the free hand flicks open toward it (contact); a 1 px recoil

ward.note: pushes the staff out ahead as a barrier, braced slightly back, and hunches 2 px down and back behind it while the free hand pulls the mantle to the chest; holds, then eases back

hit.note: spec hit: torso knocked 3 px back and 1 px down with a 3 degree lean back, head nods back 4 degrees, robe top shifts 1 px; recovered by 0.6

death.note: the staff slips from the grip at 0.2 and topples forward about its foot; the seer sinks 14 px into its robe and folds forward 20 degrees, hood bowed; the hem spreads 4 px each side; terminal pose held
